summary_reconciliation.readiness_claims: Saved PASS/HOLD/MISSING are source claims, not acceptance decisions. 30 files means claimed upstream raw set; this ZIP has only 8 CSVs. Totals, symbol/date/industry summaries reconcile to this stored merged sample.

prior_raw_reconciliation_pointer.description: Prior full raw-to-merged EQ key/value check; merged source SHA matches. Its result is reused, not represented as new upstream verification.

units.prices: Source-normalized price fields; source currency/provider/adjustment not newly verified.
units.tot_traded_value/total_turnover: Rupee turnover inherited from prior raw header Turnover ₹, not crore; no new provider reconciliation.
units.tot_traded_qty/deliv_qty/total_volume/to: Traded/deliverable quantities, not cash or ownership percentage.
units.returns/dispersion/breadth/tails/distrib: 0–1 fraction scale for percentages; returns and dispersion in fractional price-change units.
units.trades/counts/flags: Trade counts, sample-symbol counts or binary research flags as named; not shares added to universe.

independent_recomputation.definition_status: Inferred reproducing transformations; the archive does not supply formula code or timing contracts.

formulas.equal_weight_ret_1d: Mean of available close/previous stored same-symbol close - 1; no date-gap reset.
formulas.dispersion_1d: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of available same-symbol stored-close returns.
formulas.up_pct_1d/down3_pct_1d/up3_pct_1d: Count(ret1 > 0 / ret1 < -0.03 / ret1 > 0.03) divided by all source symbols on date; missing comparison=false. Result missing only when all returns missing.
formulas.tail_down3_5d/tail_up3_5d: Count(close/5th prior stored same-symbol close - 1 < -0.03 / > 0.03) divided by all source symbols on date; missing comparison=false. Result missing only when all five-observation returns missing.
formulas.total_volume/total_turnover: Sum of source tot_traded_qty / tot_traded_value by observed date.
formulas.avg_delivery_pct/avg_trades: Mean of nonmissing source deliv_perc / total_trades.
formulas.total_delivery_qty: Missing-skipping sum of deliv_qty; all-missing groups become zero.
formulas.volume_hhi/delivery_hhi: Sum of squared stock quantity shares of daily total, with zero denominator missing.
formulas.tail_repair_ratio_5d: tail_up3_5d / tail_down3_5d; zero denominator gives missing.
formulas.sample_tail_damage_q90_fire/sample_tail_: Reproduced by tail_down3_5d >= its full-sample q90/q95; missing comparisons give zero. Producer/calibration timestamp not supplied.
formulas.sample_damage_cluster_5in10: Reproduced by count of q90 fires in trailing 10 observations >=5. min_periods=1 and min_periods=10 both match; initial-window policy cannot be uniquely identified.

unresolved_trigger_generation.candidate_family: High delivery percent above own full-window rolling20/60 mean times1.0/1.1/1.2 or q70/q80/q90, AND negative/positive stored-close return. Exploratory rejection only; no inferred approved replacement.
